products.name: OPPO Pad 3
products.description:
OPPO Pad 3 Matte Display Edition

The OPPO Pad 3 is a premium tablet designed to deliver powerful performance, immersive visuals, and long‑lasting battery life. With its sleek design, advanced hardware, and modern software, it’s built to be the perfect companion for entertainment, study, and everyday use.

Immersive 11‑Inch Display

The OPPO Pad 3 features an 11.61‑inch IPS LCD display with a sharp 2800 × 2000 resolution and ~296 PPI pixel density. Supporting 1 billion colors, 96% NTSC coverage, and 97.4% DCI‑P3, it ensures vibrant and accurate visuals. With adaptive refresh rates up to 144Hz and brightness up to 700 nits, the OPPO 11 inch Tab is perfect for streaming, browsing, and creative work in any environment. For users who prefer reduced glare and enhanced readability, the OPPO Pad 3 also offers a Matte Display Edition, designed to minimize reflections and provide a paper‑like viewing experience, ideal for reading and productivity.

Powerful Performance & Storage

Powered by the Mediatek Dimensity 8350 (4nm) chipset and Mali G615‑MC6 GPU, the OPPO Pad 3 Tablet delivers smooth multitasking and efficient performance. Its octa‑core CPU architecture, combined with 8GB LPDDR5x RAM and 256GB UFS 4.0 storage, ensures fast app launches and ample space for files, photos, and videos. Running on Android 15 with ColorOS 15, it offers a modern, intuitive interface with enhanced productivity features.

Audio & Entertainment

The OPPO Tab comes equipped with quad stereo speakers, delivering immersive sound for movies, music, and video calls. Supporting SBC, AAC, LHDC, and LDAC codecs, it ensures high‑quality audio across devices. Combined with its vivid display, the OPPO Pad 3 is ideal for entertainment and multimedia experiences.

Camera & Video Recording

The OPPO Pad 3 includes an 8MP rear camera with autofocus and support for 4K video recording at 30fps, along with zoom and EIS stabilization. The front 8MP camera is optimized for video calls and selfies, supporting 1080p recording with retouch mode enabled by default. Whether for casual photography or professional meetings, the cameras deliver clarity and convenience.

Battery & Fast Charging

With a massive 9520mAh battery, the OPPO Pad 3 offers reliable all‑day usage. Fast charging is supported via 67W SuperVOOC 2.0, delivering a full day’s power in just 10 minutes. This makes the OPPO Pad 3 Tablet one of the best options for users who need dependable performance without frequent charging.

Connectivity & Features

The OPPO Pad 3 supports Wi‑Fi 6 dual‑band, Bluetooth 5.4, and USB Type‑C 3.2 for fast and stable connections. It includes sensors such as accelerometer, gyroscope, geomagnetic sensor, and step counter, enhancing usability for fitness and productivity. With its slim 6.29mm profile, lightweight 536g body, and stylish silver finish, it’s designed for portability and elegance.

Why Choose OPPO Pad 3

The OPPO Pad 3 stands out as a high‑performance tablet with a 144Hz display, Dimensity 8350 processor, quad speakers, and long battery life. Whether you’re looking for an OPPO Tab for entertainment, an OPPO Pad 3 Tablet for work and study, or an OPPO 11 inch Tab for everyday use, it delivers exceptional value and versatility.
